:::{#thm-transpose-product}
#### Transpose of a product

For an $m \times k$ matrix $\matr{A}$ and a $k \times n$ matrix $\matr{B}$:

$$
\underbrace{\tp{(\matr{A}\matr{B})}}_{n \times m}
= \underbrace{\tp{\matr{B}}}_{n \times k}\,\underbrace{\tp{\matr{A}}}_{k \times m}
$$

:::

::: proof

Entry $(i, j)$ of each side:

$$
\ba
\sb{\tp{(\matr{A}\matr{B})}}_{ij}
&= (\matr{A}\matr{B})_{ji}
&& \text{(definition of the transpose)}
\\
&= \sum_{s=1}^{k} a_{js}\, b_{si}
&& \text{(definition of matrix multiplication)}
\\
&= \sum_{s=1}^{k} (\tp{\matr{B}})_{is}\, (\tp{\matr{A}})_{sj}
&& \text{(definition of the transpose; reorder each product)}
\\
&= \sb{\tp{\matr{B}}\,\tp{\matr{A}}}_{ij}
&& \text{(definition of matrix multiplication)}
\ea
$$

:::
